{{Quote|We have located the Imperial headquarters previously raided by Kyle Katarn. His report was understated, to say the least. Imperial casualties were evidently very high. We have found only one terrified survivor.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hantor Loftus]], to [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="NRIR" />}}
The '''Mission to Tatooine''' occurred in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] when independent operative [[Kyle Katarn]] raided an [[Empire Reborn]] facility on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The base was actually a recruiting station for the Empire Reborn, and was commanded by a member of the [[Reborn]], [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-imbued soldiers. Katarn killed all residents of the base, except for one soldier, who was left horrified by the encounter. [[New Republic Intelligence Service|NRI]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hantor Loftus]] later led a recovery and incarceration team to the base to clean up. Little information was gathered from the Imperial survivor but he did reveal that his orders originated from [[Kejim]].<ref name="NRIR" /> Kyle Katarn was then [[Mission to Kejim|sent]] to this planet by [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] in order to investigate the information.<ref name="JKII:JO" />
